note: Adapted from the species description of Speculitermes goesswaldi in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; no soldier is recorded, only the alate and the worker; OCR-incomplete values for the total body length of the worker and the compound-eye diameter of the alate are not recorded; synonymy citations, figure references and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and postclypeus brown; antennae and labrum pale yellow; thorax and legs pale yellow; tergites and sternites transparent, abdomen appearing grey owing to gut contents. Head sparsely pilose, body moderately pilose. Head subcircular (length to mandible base 1.08-1.17, maximum width 1.35-1.40 mm); Y-shaped suture distinct; mid-dorsal spot small, circular and white, diameter 0.07-0.09 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 long, rod-shaped and partly subdivided, segment 4 slightly smaller than segment 2. Anteclypeus either a small glabrous narrow band or a sub-trapezoidal plate with the anterior margin slightly produced. Postclypeus raised and pilose, slightly longer than half its width (length 0.35-0.37, width 0.58-0.66 mm). Labrum length 0.37-0.43, width 0.57-0.63 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.40-0.45, width 0.80-0.86 mm), anterior and posterior margins rounded, without notches. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2 or 2:2:2, dorsal spur sometimes reduced or absent.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown; mid-dorsal spot white, sometimes with scattered brown spots; postclypeus paler than head capsule; antennae and labrum pale brown; pronotum brown with a dark brown T-shaped spot; meso- and metanotum brown; tergites brown, paler medially, with one dark spot on each side; sternites pale brown, paler medially, sternites 2-6 each with one lateral spot, sternite 7 with 2 or 3 lateral spots. Head and body surface covered with a thick layer of fine hairs and several long setae. Total body length about 7.5 mm. Head subcircular, much wider than long including compound eyes (length to mandible base 1.15-1.20, width including compound eyes 1.63-1.70 mm); mid-dorsal spot white, translucent, irregular in shape (length 0.09-0.13, width 0.07-0.10 mm); Y-shaped suture incomplete or almost indiscernible. Compound eyes circular, medium-sized. Ocelli suboval, translucent, maximum diameter 0.13-0.17 mm, separated from the compound eye by about their long diameter, eye-ocellus distance 0.13-0.17 mm. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segment 4 as long as segment 2, segment 5 smaller than segment 4. Postclypeus strongly raised and pilose, longer than half its width (length 0.38-0.40, width 0.70-0.73 mm), anterior margin nearly straight, posterior margin extending deeply into the frons. Anteclypeus glabrous, either band-shaped or trapezoidal with the anterior margin produced medially. Labrum broadly ligulate to subquadrate (length 0.30-0.40, width 0.50-0.60 mm). Pronotum much wider than long (length 0.85-0.93, maximum width 1.47-1.60 mm); anterior margin nearly straight and slightly upturned, posterior margin convex with a distinct median notch. Meso- and metanotum weakly to deeply concave medially. Wing scales dark brown and pilose, fore wing scales and hind wing scales 0.70-0.75 and 0.57-0.60 mm long respectively.
